d:
Recreating the era of the old song by this beautiful "20 Old Songs Mashup" performed on one chord by Siddharth Slathia.
Songs used in this mashup cover are:
1. Bekarar karke
2. Ek ladki bheegi bhaagi si
3. Pyar hua ikrar hua
4. Suhana safar aur yeh mausam
5. Jeena yahan marna yahan
6. Mana janab ne pukara nahin
